Summary: Let the buyer beware. this product contains High fructose corn syrup AND Splenda and no juice
Text:
All Natural Flavor/no artificial color, says the bold letters on the front of the package.
When you read the nutrition label you see there are only 8 grams of sugar compare to the nearly 16 grams in comparable drinks.
No where on the package does it tell you it has artificial sweetner as well as High Fructose Corn Syrup, neither of which is exactly natural, though technically not a flavor.
Since neither the outside box or the inside package tells you the product has Splenda (the only place you see it is in the ingredients list along with water, citric acid, natural flavor (not sure where this comes from)and HFCS. Absolutely no nutrient value)
The advertisement says it is "roaring with fruity flavor" and advertises it as a wholesome drink, but to be honest, this stuff is like drinking sugar with a very artificial cherry flavor going on. It basically tastes like an overly sweet cherry sucker was melted into a little bit of water and put in a pouch. The first swig made me recoil. It is way too sweet and the only "wholesome" ingredient in it is water!
To their favor they do advertise it as a water flavored beverage, but of course the cherry on the package makes you think it has real cherry flavor and it doesn't. It may have natural flavoring, but I've never tasted a natural cherry like that.
If you want a really wholesome beverage stick to water and swish a cherry lollipop in it if you want to add some flavoring. You will cme out better than Roarin' Waters which is a Roarin' Rip Off and borders closely on false advertising. If they placed bold writing on the front that said it contained Splenda... an artificial sweetner, not a natural one, I would never have purchased it and they would have never had to deal with this negative review.
Better to be honest with people and if you are making an artificially flavored "wholesome" flavored water, do us a favor and leave out the HFCS and use Stevia and real cherry flavor. Then you might have a winner on your hands that parents would love to buy and kids would like to drink. Don't be fake with people to sell a product that is disguised as good for you when it obviously isn't!

In short, the product does not taste like natural cherries, is overly sweet, does not satisfy thirst, leaves a bad taste in your mouth that makes you want to drink some water to get rid of the sweet, cherry sucker flavor, and has not nutrient value. The most healthy ingredient in this pouch is the water. Do not be fooled by the all natural flavor, no color added description. This is not a healthy beverage and not wholesome. Convenient yes, but not a good choice for health conscious parents and their children.

Summary: Great texture, but the taste is a little off
Text:
The Healthy Choice Fresh Mixer bowl is a new, and rather unique lunch item that offers "fresh" pasta but sauce that tastes overly processed.

The bowl itself is pretty neat. Open it up, pour water up to the fill line, and put the lid back on. After you microwave it for a couple of minutes you dump out the water through the straining holes in the lid. The meat sauce is in a separate container, and after you vent the cover for that you can microwave it for a few seconds and then mix it in with your pasta. It takes about 4-5 minutes total and the people at work watching me prepare my lunch were definitely captivated.

As for the overall taste, it comes up a little short. The pasta is great, I love the fresh-like texture of it. The sauce, however, is a different story. It's ok, but has an overly spicy/tangy flavor that I can't quite describe. I feel like Healthy Choice gave it this extra spicy background flavor to cover up the fact that it's processed sauce sealed in a plastic container.

Still, the Fresh Mixer Bowl is a nice change of pace from a cold sandwich, and it's better than a microwaved bowl of Chef Boyardee stuff. I'd buy it and eat it again, just not every week. I think I'd still rate a good microwaveable bowl of soup over it if I'm looking for a packable hot lunch at work. I only tried the Ziti & Meat Sauce though, so other flavors might taste better.

Summary: Best spicy noodle on the market
Text:
Although this noodle is the "default" according to my Korean friend, I believe it is the best spicy noodle on the market. It is VERY spicy for those that are not accustomed to spicy food. If you have not tried this noodle before, I'd recommend using only half the chili powder packet. Then adjust as necessary for later meals. I've been eating this noodle for years and years. The recipe that I normally use is:

1 egg
Chinese green onions (chopped)
lemon juice
sesame oil

Bring water to a boil with the noodle in a pot. Then pour out the water and run cold water over the noodle. This cleans the noodles of the materials left over from the manufacturing process. Set noodle aside. Then bring filtered water to a boil with both ingredient packets. It takes several minutes for the dried vegetables to hydrate. Put noodles back in. Add 3-4 drops of lemon juice and 1-2 drops of sesame oil. Add the green onions. Stir. Break the egg over the top of the noodles. Make sure your hands are dry to avoid steam burns! Wait until the egg white turns from translucent to white. Serve over large bowl. Break the egg and allow the yolk to run over the noodles. YUM!

Summary: Be careful, made my dog violently ill
Text:
I must admit these do work for getting your pets to take pills - 2 very finicky dogs who almost always spit out their pills in any food did scarf their pills down when put in these. However, after only 2 pills (separated by 8 hours), one of my dogs (8 month old puppy) became violently ill about 2 hours after the 2nd pill pocket with numerous episodes of explosive diarrhea and vomiting (ultimately very bloody after 12 hours). It ended up costing us money for a vet visit and medicine to get the dog to get well, and a major scare that the puppy was going to die (could hardly move after 18 hrs of this). The medicine was not new, nor any thing else changed, so I presume it was due to these (certainly not going to try them again to see). Our other dog (adult) did fine, however. Maybe it should just not be used for puppies, or maybe it's just an unusual reaction, but if you google "pill pockets diarrhea", you will see this is an occasional known side effect.
Would suggest trying just one of these (or half of one) each of the first few days to make sure your pet is not intolerant of these. 1 out of 2 for me was not good odds.

Summary: GREAT product at an affordable price!
Text:
Contrary to what the sugar industry would love us to believe, fructose is a MUCH healthier sweetener than sucrose (white table sugar, evaporated cane juice). It is NOT the same as high fructose corn syrup (HFCS, by the way, has nearly the same molecular structure as sucrose at right around 50% glucose to 50% fructose ... so all of the health hazards announced with HFCS apply to sucrose as well ... this applies even the sneaky "evaporated cane juice", which tries to come off as a healthier sugar alternative). Glucose hits the bloodstream fast and hard, causing blood sugar to rise to very unhealthy levels, which then forces the body to release chemicals (insulin, adrenaline, etc) in order to try and bring blood sugar levels back to normal (this reaction is what causes "sugar highs and lows". On the flip side, fructose sweeteners are processed by the organs and enter the blood stream slowly and steadily, as needed. The ONLY time fructose carries health risks is when it's combined in the diet with the HEALTH-DESTRUCTIVE sweetener; sucrose! If you eliminate sucrose (common table sugar/evaporated cane juice) from your diet and replace it with a 100% fructose sweetener (fructose, agave nectar, fruit, fruit juice), you will get to enjoy MANY health benefits, some of which are: stable glucose levels, more balanced energy levels, lower cholesterol, cancer fighter (rather than being a cancer promoter like sucrose), etc. I speak from the experience of many ... myself and my family included! My husband, prior to switching completely to fructose and staying completely away from sucrose, had type II diabetes, high cholesterol and his triglycerides were through the roof (over 900!!). He was on medication for his diabetes, but didn't want to take Lipitor. Less than a year after we were married and he was completely away from sucrose, he was able to go off of his diabetes medication and his cholesterol and triglycerides were so low, his doctor stated "you just took one foot out of the grave and now have the cholesterol of a fit teen" Of course, common sense tells us that *all* sweets, even healthy sweets, need to be consumed in moderation ... too much of a good thing is still too much!
So don't buy into the fears that the sugar industry PAYS BIG BUCKS to breed ... buy into your health and enjoy this wonderful sweetener! It tastes like sugar and can be used just like sugar in recipes (you use about 25% less, so it's easier on the calories as well).

I agree that it adds a certain flavor and a bit of loft to a recipe. But, I don't think it's quite the same flavor or loft I get from real buttermilk (or what passes for real buttermilk, these days). The flavor is OK: it's just different. Also, I think the loft is more from the fact that the batters it produces are runnier (or maybe looser) than I get from buttermilk. That's probably because today's buttermilk has some form of gum added which thicken things up. Since the end result of recipes made with this differ from that of using buttermilk, it's probably just as good to use the old standby of adding a tablespoon of white vinegar to a cup of milk. The result will be different from real buttermilk, but just as equivalent as using this powdered buttermilk.

I'd definitely recommend trying this product for yourself to see if it meets your needs. It's certainly not bad, and could be just fine for you. But, in my case, I guess I'll just have to accept the spoilage of buttermilk in the refrigerator. I rate this at an OK 3 stars out of 5.

I contacted Muir Glen directly and asked whether or not their cans contained BPA. You can see their response below:

"Thank you for contacting Muir Glen about bisphenol-A or BPA.

Bisphenol-A is a component of protective coatings in metal food packaging, and provides an important food safety and quality function in canned foods. Scientific and governmental bodies worldwide have examined the science many times and have concluded that the weight of evidence supports the safety of BPA, including recent comprehensive assessments in Japan and in the European Union.

In January 2010, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration announced another review of BPA. This review in expected to take 18-24 months, and Health Canada and the World Health Organization (WHO) will participate.

Most metal cans in the food industry utilize BPA in the can lining or can lid. Some of our products do, and many competitors' products do as well.

Muir Glen continues to believe BPA is safe. However, we know that some of our consumers have wanted us to pursue alternatives. We have been working with our can suppliers and can manufacturers to develop and test alternative linings that do not use BPA for some time.

One alternative has proven safe and viable in our processing of tomatoes - and Muir Glen is in the midst of transitioning to cans with liners that do not use BPA. It is an approved non-epoxy alternative. Can coatings used by Muir Glen also comply fully with all applicable U.S. Food and Drug Administration requirements for safe use in food contact applications.

Your views are important to us. Again, thank you for contacting Muir Glen, and thank you for your support of our products.

Sincerely,

Consumer Services"

Summary: It's Corn. Cats can't live on corn.

This food is primarily corn: ground corn and corn meal. That food pyramid above the cat's head definitely doesn't represent what's in the food. And most of the meat is a byproduct, which is a low grade and questionable ingredient. So is "animal fat." It also contains wheat, which cats can easily be allergic to. This brand may be better than the bottom of the barrel cat foods, but it's still something to totally avoid. Purchase a cat food that is low in grains/carbs or has none at all. If it contains any then they should be wholegrain, like brown rice. No corn or byproducts.

Your cat may seem fine on this food, but like a person eating fast food at every meal, you have to know there are healthier options out there and such poor dietary choices will catch up with you sometime.

Charlie

Summary: The yummy goodness of dried Sichuan peppers
Text:
Sometimes a new flavor is off-putting. Sometimes we have to try it a few times before we get past the unfamiliarity and are able to appreciate the new sensations our tongue is telling us. But sometimes you try something new, and you just think "Yum!"

That is what happened to me when I was living in Japan, and I reached for the unfamiliar little green bottle with the indecipherable writing and sprinkled some on my food. Yum.

Sansho is the dried and ground husk of the Sichuan pepper, which is neither a peppercorn nor a chili pepper. It looks more like a berry when you see it on the tree, or like a coffee bean. The peppers are used widely in Asian cooking, especially Chinese Sichuan (also spelled "Szechwan") cooking. Sansho has the unique quality of slightly numbing the tongue, which allows you to experience more of the flavor and less of the heat of other peppers. That makes it is one of the key ingredients in the famous Chinese 5-Spice and the Japanese 7-Spice blends.

On its own, sansho doesn't taste like pepper. It has a more aromatic character, almost a lemony/spicy quality. In Japan, it is said that sansho tastes like spring. The spice is traditionally used on unagi eel, or as a topping for hot noodle broths like udon.

Personally, I can put sansho on pretty much anything. It tastes great on scrambled eggs or pan-fried potatoes. I even recently made a batch of sansho chicken sausage that turned out fantastic. If you give it a taste, you will soon find plenty of foods that you think will benefit from a sprinkling of sansho.

This little green "S & B Sansho" bottle is about as ubiquitous as it gets in Japan. I don't know if I had any other kind of sansho, and I am thrilled that I can still get this in the US.

One thing that is inaccurate in their packaging is the meaning of the word namaste. According to the Oxford English Dictionary, Draft Revision June 2003, taken literally, it means "I bow to you". The word is derived from Sanskrit (namas): to bow, obeisance, reverential salutation, and (te): "to you".

Some Hindus believe that this greeting recognizes the divinity in eachother, while others feel it is only a sign of deep respect.

Despite the inaccuracy ("no literal translation"), the name of the food is apropos to its contents. They are showing respect to those who suffer gluten sensitivity, and are evoking respect for their product through its name.

Summary: Tender as promised, but more salt and gristle than bargained for
Text:
By now I've eaten half the bag so I know what's in here. Sure, their beef jerky is pretty tender. But for some reason they decided to throw in an insane amount of salt. I've had store-bought beef jerky and I've had quality Amazon beef jerky and this is definitely the saltiest by at least double. The first time I ate this, I could only handle 2 strips before I had to put it down again. My friend made a disgusted face and refused to have another bite. Luckily I am a salt lover so I can at least tolerate the extreme saltiness. But it's still too salty.

Next up is the gristle. Sometimes amidst the generally tender bites there will be a mat of unchewable mass that I pretty much have to spit out or swallow whole. It happens more often than other brands and definitely more than I care for. Secondly, I don't know if it's the salt playing tricks on me, but the texture and taste is a bit worse than other brands, like they use lower quality jerky.

Overall I believe that Wild Ride is less quality than most other brands, even when you factor in the low price. There are similarly priced brands that are of higher quality and lower sodium content. I don't know why they sell so well. Personally my next bulk order beef jerky will be with someone else.

Summary: I Was Surprised At How Well This Worked
Text:
We have four types of hair in our home- baby fine and wavy, medium fine and straight, coarse oily and wavy, and dry brittle and wavy with color treatment.

When trying the Clear Scalp Shea Smooth & Nourish Conditioner, I expected greasy useless performance, but in once case I was wrong!

When using various shampoo with it, this conditioner left the hair beautifully shiny, soft, and very curly and wavy. The color was enhanced nicely too.

So, despite having a not to impressed outlook, this conditioner turned out to be a fantastic find and I know at least one person in our household will be using it until it is gone and most likely repurchasing too!

We also like the way the container is made. It stands up straight, does not leak, and dispenses the conditioner just right. The scent is fresh and fruity/herbal very reminiscent of a high end brand which works well too.

Nature's Path "Organic Crunchy Vanilla Sunrise" is a delicious cereal.

Unfortunately cereals are not healthy, but as far as cereals go this is one of the better ones.

The sugar to fiber ratio is 2.3 to 1 (7 grams of sugar for every 3 grams of fiber). The "best" cereals are about 1:1. As a rule of thumb I won't eat anything with a sugar to fiber ratio higher than 3 to 1, so Crunchy Vanilla Sunrise qualifies as acceptable.

If you are going to eat cereal, this is a good organic choice.

I'm very impressed by Nature Path's program to buy land and allow organic farmers to use the land for free.

The primary ingredient in Crunchy Vanilla Sunrise is corn. ("organic whole grain corn meal") Followed by sugar and then organic brown rice flour. There are eleven more ingredients and none of them are "incomprehensible chemical names". The only potentially "bad" ingredient is "natural vanilla flavor" (which technically could be darn near anything).

All in all, a fairly good cereal with a very nice flavor. Enjoy it in moderation.

I brewed that first Kahlua k-cup, and the smell only got stronger. Uh-oh.

I added sugar and milk and drank the resulting stinkfest. It didn't taste nearly as bad as it smelled. But that's hardly a ringing endorsement of this coffee, is it? I came to Amazon and noticed that Kahlua k-cups happened to be in my Gold Box today. Out of curiosity, I clicked on the link to read other people's reviews, and I could suddenly identify the odd stink from these k-cups: yes, it's skunk, just as other reviewers said! These k-cups, and now my entire house, smell like skunk spray.

I'm off to throw out my remaining Kahlua k-cups, wash my hand (which smells just from handling the k-cup) and clean my Keurig brewer. Maybe some Lysol will let me keep my house, rather than having to move out. ;-)

Needless to say, I don't recommend anyone else purchase this particular variety of k-cup, unless they enjoy skunk-scented coffee. On the other hand, it certainly will wake you up in the morning.

It's not that sweet and it's not that lemony by itself.  You can make a better quick bread from scratch.  Quick breads are very easy to make, unlike cakes, for instance.  Plus you can put lemon zest in it and real fresh lemon juice.  You'll get a much better bread that way.

There's a difference between all-natural and organic. Poisonous mushrooms are all-natural, proving that foods that boast about naturalness aren't necessarily all that impressive. Organic means that the food is made from some of the healthiest ingredients available, and this granola is organic.

Now, while we've established that this granola is healthy, there's still the issue of taste. Too often, organic food is extraordinarily healthy but tastes like cardboard coated with mud. Thankfully, that is not the case with Love Crunch! My taste buds tingled with every tantalizing bite of this delectable granola, and I could rest assured that I was getting a good source of fiber and many other nutrients. There were chunks of dark chocolate and berries mingling with the granola clusters that would excite my tongue even more when I would munch on one of those.

Some other reviewers have stated that they found this to be more of a snack food than a breakfast food; honestly, I would use it for both. I found that I was reaching for this in the morning more often than my Cheerios Honey Nut Cereal, however, there were also times when I would be snacking on it in the afternoon. It's so good for any time of the day or any type of preparation. If you like your granola with milk or yogurt, this will work very well for that. I ate it plain most of the time, but it really can be used any way you would normally use granola, except for maybe baking.

Overall, I love this stuff, and I will most likely be buying more soon. It's probably most comparable to Special K Chocolatey Delight Cereal but with healthier and more delicious ingredients (and granola instead of cereal flakes). I highly recommend this to granola/chocolate enthusiasts. It's organic, but it's also good.

Summary: Will Not Feed My Puppy Anything Else
Text:
After adopting our lab/boxer mix, Nero, we quickly found out that he was very particular about what he ate. We tried everything, but still he wouldn't eat. We went for a couple of weeks like this. We started worrying and even took him to the shelter/vet and asked what we should do. They only said, "don't worry, he will ear eventually." We tried everything from Eukanuba, to Science diet, you name it we probably tried it. We ended up with a cupboard full of bags that had less than a cup of food taken out of each. He eventually started eating a little, I guess just enough to have something in his stomach, but not nearly the amount he should be eating. It was pretty stressfull, as this was our first time actually owning a dog. It got to the point where we'd walk him, and people would comment about how skinny he was. Sad, I know.

Finally someone recommended we try Wellness. Now, I will say that we were a little hesitant at first, because it was a bit on the pricey side. And we really didn't know that much about pet food. We figured, you know, he's a dog, so long as he's not eating table scraps, it shouldn't matter that much (read: we were very ignorant). Boy were we wrong, and since then, we've come a long way. After checking out the Wellness site and really doing some research, we decided that it was worth it. So we bought a little bag to, you know, try it out. Just in case Nero didn't like it. To our surprise, he loved the stuff! Scarfed it down like I've never seen him do before. My boyfriend and I both stood there silently while we watched him eat a whole bowl of food for the first time.

Needless to say, after that we went online and bought a whole 30-pound bag. I love that my dog loves this stuff, and I love that it's also good for him. I mean, this stuff is human-grade. HUMAN GRADE!

People are also always commenting on how good our dog looks, how shiny his coat is. It's definitely noticeable that he's eating well. We saw his sibling who, sadly, is still in the shelter, and you can tell the difference between the two dogs, just by looking at their coat, and I know it's because of Wellness.

And because of that, I will NEVER feed my dog anything else. Ever!

I found the coffee a bit pricey but worth the cost- I was very pleased to get such prompt and efficent service. I was a bit suprised because of the shipping from a surgical supply firm - but had no problem at all.

Summary: Not the best for your cat's long term health
Text:
I started buying these after another brand discontinued. I refuse to buy by-products for my cat so of course I was drawn to Puurfectly because it has real meat. The downside, 2 "magical" ingredients:

Corn Starch-Modified, Wheat Gluten

Both useless to your cat and in my case eventually cause my cat to develop an allergy to corn and wheat. After a few months of her loving this food, she now refuses to touch it after throwing up repeatedly from it and having severe diarrhea.

So now being more informed that corn and wheat aren't great for cats I've move on to natural cat foods. No more throwing up and a happy cat. Hooray! I suggest you do the same if you want to avoid vet bills and chronic health conditions in the long run.

You can get one pack (2count) at Kroger for .97 and at walmart for .94  and if you are signed up for coupons you get $1 off 3 or 4 packages. These are price slightly high. If you like convince of not leaving your home, then go for it.

Summary: Great taste, why so expensive, Amazon?
Text: I LOVE this oatmeal- and this is my favorite flavor. But I don't understand why it's so expensive. It is hard to find at some grocery stores in my area. But the ones who sell it do so for less than $2/box... not $7!
Disappointing quality in this slide bar shower head. The caps that cover the mounting screws do not stay on, the angle adjustment for the shower head is weak, and the soapdish is cheap.

Like another reviewer said, this cat food literally saved our pet's life. He couldn't keep any type of food down but was always starving. He would gobble down whole cans of food and then immediately throw it back up. The vet's only recommendation was to keep switching to different brands of food -- at no time did he tell us to avoid the filler that most manufacturers add to their food. After a little searching on the internet, I saw that perhaps it was the additional ingredients which may be the cause of his upset stomach. By Nature was the only brand at PetSmart that had such a high content of natural ingredients, both in the dry and canned food; it doesn't contain corn, wheat or soy. He's been eating By Nature for 2 weeks now, is looking much better and has gained back some of his weight. Yes, it's more expensive than the other brands but it's well worth it for a happy, healthy cat.
I am very pleased with the Stash tea I purchased.  It was a VERY good deal & the quality is excellent
this product would be great if it was not so high in sodium (salt). 12oz package has 850mg sodium for a half cup.  I will not buy this again.

Regular popcorn makes me cough because of its dryness and its loose kernels. The Kettle Popcorners are a delicious alternative. I don't have a problem with eating the Popcorners, and they aren't as messy as regular popcorn.

I made a peanut sauce with this and it was very good though not as smooth as with real PB. My beef with it is the lack of basic instructions on how much powder and water to use to make basic peanut butter.- there are recipes other website but not specific guidance on the mix you would use if just substituting peanut butter. Am I an idiot? Maybe... Still, if you need 2Tbs of peanut butter you will use almost 4 Tbs. I have only used it once so did not get good measurements because there was lots of adding more water or powder and also I usually weigh ingredients and as another reviewer pointed out the weight and volume on the label didn't match. This of course affects the calories and if you are counting them this matters to you.
I read reviews about price and didn't think much of it- it didn't seem that bad for a jar of PB but in a recipe that used 1/2c of PB I used at least 1/3rd of the jar so yeah, kinda pricey... It is what it is and I won't knock a star off but just keep in mind that this does not make a jar of PB which should have been obvious but then maybe I'm an idiot!

These are great treats to use with the large blue disk like things.  The disc like things are good for hiding food and then my miniature schnauzer has to work to get them out.  If I put one of these treats on top she is trying to eat this thing for hours then can't even get it all, so it lasts for a few days before I have to take the treat out so she can finish it.  But I would definitely recommend this with the large blue disk like things as a toy that keeps a dog occupied for a pretty long time.

Summary: I remember better, but not too shabby...
Text: These suckers (sorry for the pun) are getting hard to find, so I appreciate what I can get.  Mom and I both agree these are a bit less salty tasting than most we've encountered over the last 50 years.  Besides a bit saltier taste, I would prefer if these Salmiak Pastillen were firmer/harder. Unfortunately, I don't have the willpower to open them and let them sit around long enough for that to happen :-)  Overall, I'm glad I bought their last 11 bags.

I do not understand all of the negative reviews. I think this popcorn and the design of the bowl are wonderful. I like to have popcorn on my lunch break at work and there are no big popcorn bowls. Now I no longer have to reach inside a greasy bag to get to the popcorn. I did not notice any unpleasant taste at all.

Summary: Makes an excellent cup of tea!
Text:
I am so glad Amazon carries this tea, and that too at a very competitive price point. I used to purchase from andronicos for nearly twice as much!

This tea is makes a strong cup, but never bitter - even when over steeped. Flavor comes trough nice and strong even when prepared with milk. Great breakfast tea I would highly recommend!

I recently moved to Colorado, where it is always dry. Moisturizing body lotions alone just don't cut it for me. A friend introduced me to Nature's Way Coconut Oil and I fell in love. I mix it with my regular body lotion before applying it. My skin stays moisturized, feels baby soft, and does not feel oily. I have a problem with fragrances in general, and was at first worried about smelling like a coconut. However, that is not a problem at all; there is no scent. I've ordered this product twice so far and will continue to do so.

I own a bread machine and use honey for my whole wheat loaves.  This product works great for a few weeks, but then something happens to the honey.  It gets thicker.  (And this was in bottles that were sealed and unopened).  This resulted in my bread not mixing properly.  The dough would get clumpy and would not blend together properly.  I had to throw out half of the honey.
Just as good as the other Clif bars, but dry and crunchy. Tasty, portable, and cheaper than the others. Perfect snack.

These snaps are not too sweet; they have a strong ginger bite (in a good way). They're fairly crisp, but with a little chew to them at the end - almost like they have tiny slivers of candied ginger in them? The molasses taste is there, but it's subtle. I haven't tried this out, but I think they'd also make a good base for a cookie crust. The small size is nice, too - good for a little treat, or a treat for a little one. They're a good contrast to the recipe I use for homemade (which is very molasses-y, and very soft). I'm not over the moon about them, but I do keep eating them...  I wouldn't buy them all the time, but they're a great choice to save time or make a less rich pie crust - and I'm happy to support a company that does a lot of organic products and is conscientious about its use of palm fruit oil (non-hydrogenated, sourced in Columbia where its production supports an indigenous population).

Summary: Show cats with sensitive digestive systems
Text:
Have been buying this for years for my Burmese show cats, at the recommendation of my vet, at Petsmart.
Cheaper on Amazon and it is delivered right to my door so I don't have to make a special retail stop in my car!
I have not yet tried these crackers with s'mores, but they are very good with any kind of frosting, especially cream cheese frosting - a nice, quick treat that is gluten free.
Our little teacup yorkie just LOVES this ducky treat!  It is worth trying for your dog...

I have been looking for more of this in groceries stores and haven't found any and I'm close to running out...Thank goodness for Amazon!  I use this on tuna sandwiches, BLT's, I add it to basalmic salad dressing and today I'm using it as part of a marinade for skirt steak.  This is one of my favorite ingredients to add to recipes to add a little zip (or more if you're inclined to).  BUY IT!
Great taste.  Almonds are high in overall fat but low in saturated fats that most contribute to weight gain.  Buy a case; they stay pretty fresh when sealed for 6 months

These taste great and are full of fruit. The problem I have with them is they are too sticky and not really good for the filling in my teeth. I don't think they'd be good for the filling in anyone's teeth.

Summary: Great biscuits. The packaging is very good.
Text: We were looking for a good-quality tea biscuit and searched Amazon for some with favorable reviews. These seemed to fit the bill so we ordered some. They are simply a perfect biscuit. They are tender and flaky and absorb tea without falling apart (as long as you dunk them quickly). I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a delicious biscuit.

I purchased the four pack of two pancake mixes and two hot cereal blends and the 5-grain pancake is a delicious blend.

I found that I prefer using the recipe from my Betty Crocker Cookbook with two eggs, and other minor differences, rather than the recipe listed on the package which uses only one egg. The buttermilk variety was very good as well, but the five-grain is our favorite.

Saddly, I won't get to write a review about how the candy bars tasted because they were allowed to melt in the mailbox in 90 degree heat. The shipper Indulgence chose to carelessly ship the product in a USPS mailer that had no markings stating that the contents were temperature sensitive or perishable. Had they made that simple effort, my postman would have never left them to be destroyed in the heat. There was a cooling packet in the box but without any insulation...that effort was surely moot.

When we contacted them about getting a replacement...they simply suggested that we wait until winter to order any Candy from them. Our suggestions to mark the packages fell on deaf ears. If you live anywhere that is warm at all...don't order and perishibles from them.

These chips are somewhat expensive, but there really is no substitute for green mint chips, and they are darn near impossible to find in grocery stores. They make all of your minty baked goods so much tastier, and you don't have to worry about coloring white chocolate with food coloring if you are making holiday treats (Christmas, St. Patrick's Day, etc.). I find myself using half a bag to make something and munching on the rest of the bag throughout the next week or so. They are also great as an ice cream topping!

It is kind of a bummer that you have to buy six bags at once, but they are so good, you won't have any trouble finding ways to use them! They are a must-have for any mint-chocolaphile.
I love this green mountIn coffee it is so good my whole family drinks it, doesn't compare to other coffees, it is just right not too strong, I also buy the decaf brand.

Happy to see one of my numerous cats  favorites available for mail order.  Given the price, the fact I have to drive a distance to buy it and the general convenience of buying in bulk, I feel it is a good deal.

exactly as described and love the versatility  I am moving to a new condo with much more counter space and will be able to use it on the counter, but is quite useful in a spare drawer right under my Cuisenart one cup maker.

I just LOVE this stuff.  I eat for breakfast almost every day.  I have a gluten allergy and I've never had a problem with digesting this granola.  I'm not usually a big granola lover.  Often granola will be too heavy and have too many seeds in it, but this granola is nothing like that.  Great stuff.
Excellent flavor and makes quite a few patties per box. I would suggest frying them though as baking them tends to really dry them out.

This is a good hot cocoa.  It is really good for someone who is looking for all the taste of hot cocoa but wants to limit their caffeine intake, it is 99% caffeine free.  Also it has some needed vitamins that many woman are looking for at different times in their life.

We have two Great Pyrenees. One is 13 and the other is turning 9. As with all large breed dogs hips are a problem. What is more of a problem is getting them to take medications. Happy Hips is the solution. Our doggies love the taste, and they get the meds they need.

Summary: Wonderful- if you have the time!
Text:
I love oatmeal, and I really love McCann's- it has that nutty flavor you just don't find in quick oats. My morning schedule means I can't eat it every day, but I do enjoy it on weekends.

Most of us grew up on rolled oats, or instant oatmeal, and as a consequience, most of us have never tasted the real thing. And there's a huge difference. It's like comparing instant coffee with brewed coffee, or minute rice with real steamed rice. Trust me, if you've never had real, traditional, steel-cut oatmeal- well, you've never had oatmeal.

If you can't have a real chai latte this is the next best thing.  It's pretty darn good for a powdered mix.  It's great for travel, camping, or to have on hand at home in case you have a chai emergency and must have chai NOW!  I am a chai addict and must have it every day, so believe me, I know my chai.  Of course the real stuff is better, but again this is pretty good for powder.

Summary: I am not a dog, but....
Text: I am not a dog, but my pug seems to like the food. I decided to choose this food because of the quality of the manufacturer. So far the dog loves the food, and the transition from the old to the new has not caused any problems. I also like the price of the food, and will continue to use this product.

Summary: Good tasting, not too sweet, low calories
Text:
These bars have 4g fiber, 4g protein, and 110 calories (25 from fat). They are pretty tasty, not too sweet, peanut butter and chocolate flavor with rice/oats, and various sweetners. Not bad for a quick snack that's not too loaded. I like them and would buy more if I can find them at a reasonable price. I chill mine in the fridge for a little extra crunch.

I would not really call these "granola" bars, myself, but they do satisfy as a quick snack.

Summary: Tasty chocolate but very light ginger flavoring
Text:
The box contains 8 cookies, with each cookie just a little over 2 inches in diameter. About 1/3 of each cookie is covered in chocolate. I had the same problem that others did - the cookies arrived and the chocolate had melted and then hardened, making it difficult to eat a single cookie - they kept breaking into pieces.

Taste-wise, I did find that they had a slightly gritty texture, not uncommon with vegan cookies. The cookies are soft with a light ginger flavoring. While I don't care for a strong ginger taste, I would have liked a bit stronger flavoring as these seemed rather bland. Even though it had melted, I found the chocolate to be rich and tasty. The combination of the rich chocolate and the ginger taste works well together.

These cookies are a product of Scotland. While there is a list of ingredients, nutritional information is not listed on the package.

If you're looking for vegan or gluten-free cookies, you may want to try these cookies. I think if you're just looking for a tasty cookie, you probably want to pass.

With two Old English Sheepdog puppies, 18 weeks old, and with both having loose stools, I needed something all natural, with no soy or grains (OES are very allergic).  Wellness Large Breed cured the runs within a day, and the pups are loving eating it!  They finish every bowl, and never dawdle.  Their poo is solid, complete, and small.  No gas.  Great stuff!

I love almond extract and almonds are my favorite nut (although I don't think they taste alike...).  This is a great product for flavoring most anything dessert-like.  I use it almost daily in either my cold or hot cereal.  It's also great for pancakes and waffles, biscuits, cookies, quick breads and other baking, smoothies/shakes, yogurt, pretty much anything sweet.  That is, if you like the flavor, of course!  Tried another organic brand but this is less expensive and I could not tell any difference in flavor. Highly recommended!

Summary: Skinners Raisin Bran - The First Raisin Bran Made
Text: I believe this is the best tasting Raisin Bran ever made.  My Mom bought it for me when I was a little girl and I've loved it ever since!  It has the best fiber content of any raisin bran on the market; no soggy thin flakes with a raisin here and there.  It is chock full of plump, juicy raisins and delicious bran flakes.  I was so happy to have found that Amazon.com carried it. It really is the very first raisin brand ever made.  It's been my favorite for 58 years, and I guess that says there's  something really terrific about this breakfast cereal!  Thanks U.S. Mills and Amazon.com.
For a Brit on a budget that CRAVES the best candy bar in the world, I want to say THANK YOU!  The price was amazing.  The shipping was great.  Would definately buy again.

If your baby is starting with solids, I recommend you to have these and make juice of it.
He will need the water and the prunes are grate to aid the digestion. So, win-win.
I'm using one every other day. Helps a lot.

I have 2 Pomeranians that both ADORE this food! They never get tired of it. Both the canned and the dry dog food, particularly the Chicken and Rice, are excellent. You can see the pieces of rice, and it doesn't smell offensive like some of the other canned dog foods. I notice their nails and coats are strong and healthy, too! This is the BEST dog food! And trust me, I've tried many... A++++ for Canidae! The only drawback is shipping cost... If anyone knows where they offer free shipping, please let me know :) THANKS!

I love this stuff, it's delish, it's gr8 hot, easy to prepare, however, this price is INSANELY RIDICULOUS.. go to walmart, it's there on the shelf, same exact thing, 3.38 per box, hello, 8 pks. in the box, you could have 10 boxes, 80 packs for that 30plus price tag, or, a tank of gas to get to the store, either way, drive, for this item, it's cheaper

The package arrived ontime and as described.  The reason I ordered online was that it was not available in local stores and it is my favorite gum.  Unfortunately, it was a bit old and stale. Fresh date was in a month, which for individually wrapped gun it should have been a year or more.  Found a new supply and will order there from now on.

We are Chocolate Moose & Mickey Moose,

Our nice owner bought this great food for us. We love it very much, I have gained 5 lbs. because I eat all of Mickey's food when he isn't looking! Our skin and fur is much better now too. :)

Summary: The best new beverage in America
Text: This is a wonderful new drink.  I look forward to having it owned and distributed by one of the majors so that I could easily purchase it locally.  A big hit with family and friends.  Refreshing, tasty, thirst-quenching...terrific!

I love these KIND Fruit and Nut bars! Because they are based on nuts instead of granola, they are naturally gluten-free. Since I have to eat gluten-free for my health, they are a wonderful thing to carry around in my purse for "emergencies". One of these bars keeps me satisfied for a couple of hours, giving me time to figure out where I can get safe food.

I'm pretty sure that even if I found out I could eat gluten tomorrow (not likely) then I would still keep these around. Enjoy!

It says almond blend, but it doesn't smell any almond, maybe there is only 0.00001% of the almond in the ingredients. It's pretty much rice powder, if you are OK to pay the price for rice powder, it's the choice. very disappointed.

This tea tastes great, has no caffeine and makes a great refreshing drink any time of day.  Tastes good hot or cold and is very reasonably priced.  If you are thinking about ordering it, definitely give it a go.  I'm pretty picky about teas and this one gets 5 stars!

Ive always been a big Jack Links jerky fan. I usually buy a couple bags a month, but last month I was in Vegas and they were out of A1 flavor...my personal favorite!

I looked around the store and found these! I opened the bag and had a few on my way to the pool, they were awesome. Anybody that loves chicken wings should give these a taste. The chicken is tender and quite generous in size. I was pretty surprised they even brought a bead of sweat to my forehead, usually store bought "buffalo" flavors don't accomplish that.

As another reviewer said these are great if you love chicken wings but don't wanna down 200 calories a piece for that spicy burn. I do have to say these are impossible to find in WI though, so luckily amazon has them, and at a good price for a pack of 8 bags!

I've been drinking coffee for a little over 50 years. I started too young with the strong, black kind. No cream or sugar, just super straight! Lots of it, every day, daylight to dark. I built up such an immunity to the caffeine no way it kept me awake. Didn't give me any extra energy either. What it did do was help raise my blood pressure! So, along comes Taster's Choice. It's instant, oh God, not brewed, not dripped, not steamed, it's instant. That can't be good now can it? On top of that it's {{{shudder}}} DECAF! I've had to give up so much. Smoking, refined sugar, white flour, salt! It isn't fair that I now have to settle for Instant Coffee and Decaf to boot. **sigh** I begrudgingly fixed a cup, followed the directions. I looked at it for a bit before that first sip. I finally put it to my lips and *slurp*. Hmmm, not too bad, but then it was still pretty hot so I waited again and then took a gulp. I waited for the gag reflex to set in. It didn't happen. Hmmm again. As it turns out, it was pretty darn good. I have to be fair, it's darn good and I can easily live with it. It's well worth the price (compare the same in the stores, weight etc. and all) I just may actually live longer as a result and as Martha says "That's a good thing".
Love this Cornbread Mix, very moist when the others are dry and crumbly. well worth it.

This tea tastes great. The peach flavor is just enough to give the tea a bit of sweetness. Its not overpowering. My pantry looks ridiculous with how much tea I have in it, and adding another big box to the collection doesn't help, but it is more than worth it for the price.
Nowhere did it say "SMOKE" flavor in this ad - except in the little image - now I see it on the bag - just to the right of the logo, that faint beige spot. Urk.

Green Mountain "Nantucket Blend" K-Cups make a very good cup of coffee in my Keurig B-40 B40 Elite Gourmet Single-Cup Home-Brewing System. This is a very smooth tasting brew that my wife prefers over the Coffee People, Donut Shop K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 50) [Amazon Frustration-Free Packaging] I generally drink in the morning.

These are good on both "Small" and "Large" cup settings as well.

Highly Recommended!

My infant son loves most of this food.  It is easy to get cases shipped and not fumble with individual jars in the store.  Quick shipping, good packaging.  I've had no issues.

Seems like Dove came out with a new scent? I have 28 bars that dont' smell quite as good as the usual product bought from a local pharmacy or another seller on Amazon.com.  The soap does feel the same on my skin. I have already started using them and don't want to take the time or energy to return them.  Next time I'll check the seller.

NOTE: This product probably works best if you are going to put them in a thermos, but it doesn't work that well if just placed in a coffee cup.

I purchased these back when it was a kickstarter campaign.

I'm the type of person who likes a hot cup of coffee and I tend to sip slowly so I find myself going to the microwave to heat up my cup all the time. I thought this would be the perfect solution.

I did follow instructions to warm them up first. I would pour boiling water over them for 4 minutes while my press-pot coffee brewed. I would then pour out the water from the cup and pour my coffee onto the now-hot Joulies.

For me, there was absolutely no noticeable difference in how fast my coffee got cold - so I'd have to go through the extra step of pouring the coffee into a different cup so I could microwave it as the Joulies can't be microwaved. What a Pain.

I tried them every day for a week to make sure I wasn't doing something wrong and then put them in a drawer someplace where unused kitchen gadgets go to die.

I tried them in a thermos a few times and they seems to work ok (thus the 2 stars) but I don't really use a thermos all that often. So, for my purposes (keeping a cup of coffee hot) they did absolutely nothing.
This spice is absolutely delicious.  It's a huge savings and my Muligatawny soup was superb!  Compare a l ounce jar in the store for $8.00 to this package of 7 ounces for the same price or less.

Summary: Great bread for a gluten free diet
Text: My son is on a gluten free diet and he has had a really hard time without his bread!  This bread tastes good and is very easy to make in the bread maker.  I have tried to make several different gluten free breads from scratch and they either taste terrible or don't hold together.

WONDERFUL TEA!  Much better than their tea bags.  This is a MUST HAVE in our home as we both enjoy a cuppa to start and end most days.  We were using the actual tea bags for years.  We didn't think that we'd change as it was so inexpensive as we each reused a tea bag for our days cuppa.  While using the K-cups is not as cost effective, IT CERTAINLY DOES MAKE EACH CUP A PERFECT EXPERIENCE!!!!

Summary: Surprise!  A sweetened drink that is not too sweet
Text:
I was very disappointed when I found this coffed drink contained sugar. I drink my coffee & expresso black, and I find soft drinks to be too sweet and thick. I dilute diet colas with sparkling water.

So it was really nice to try this coffee drink, and find that the bitterness and the sweetness were in a nice balance, to my taste. And the thickness than many sugared soft drinks have was not present in this drink.

I'd still prefer an unsweetened version, but this was a nice surprise.
Zevia is probably the best line of natural sodas available. Lime and Cherry Cola Zevias are among their best, along with Doctor Zevia.
Smooth with a hint of flavor.  Medium boldness yet rich in taste.  Not a "wake me up" but certainly enjoyable!

I've been consuming about 1 tablespoon twice per day, soaked for at least 15 minutes, followed by an equal amount of water. They help me feel more full throughout the day and thus I am able to consume less calories. The additional protein and fiber is an added bonus.
This tea is best hot..  It's ok cold but I usually drink it plain and imagine it would probably taste better with stevia leaf or xylitol sweetner..
These treats are excellent for training. My dogs love the (safe) peanut butter flavor. They come running when they hear the pouch open! A tad pricey, but worth it.

Called a stew, but it's really a soft pate, and with big chunks of green beans and carrots.  Overall my cat seems to like it okay -- not a difficult task for him to work around the vegetables and leave them in the plate.

Delicious!!!! This is the second time I bought these quality chocolates.  I'm sticking to these, had a bad experince with Swiss Colony. Saks 5th avenue sells a similar one for much more but the quality is not there.  Hurray Seattle please don't change the Champagne Chocolates!!!  Loved them.

At first, my cat Timmy was hesitant to try the unusual looking cat food I put before him--a cross between spam and chicken soup. But after he gave it a few sniffs, it was chowed down in minutes. Timmy quickly devoured what appeared to be a delicacy to him.

To me, it looked too healthy to appeal to a feline, with its obvious chunks of veggies and solid pieces of meat, nicely moistened by a broth. The can is compact and easy to store and the portion size is just right for one cat's healthy appetite. Normally, a regular can of food like Friskies or Whiskas will only get half eaten, but there was no waste here. The food was polished off with a meticulous licked-clean plate, evidence of Timmy's approval of this latest offering.

Petite Cuisine is not cheap, but it is on the lower end for the "gourmet" cat foods and you get quality ingredients. Each 4-pack I received also came with coupons worth up to $2 in savings so that is an added bonus.

All in all, a good cat food worth it's cost. Timmy has already put in a request to sample the fish flavors. :)

I'm a huge fan of ready to go drinks and smoothies, and when I saw these in my local health food store, I almost became giddy. After tasting it, I DID become giddy! This stuff not only tastes AMAZING, but it's also the healthiest ready to go drink on the market. Digests well, tastes amazing, very nutritious.

My ONLY problem with this formulation is the use of Cane Sugar as the sweetener. This formulation, if it's supposed to be truly healthy, should replace the cane sugar with brown rice syrup, or some other sweetener with nutritive properties. Cane sugar is damaging to the body, even when "organic".

We drink Crystal Light Lemonade mix all the time.  It is one of the few 0 calorie drinks that seems to leave no aftertaste.  The Margarita Mix is tasty and almost as good as expensive premixes.  It makes a super summertime refreshment.

Summary: Great with chicken & veggies - add more peanuts!
Text:
I've bought this item a hundred times at my local grocery store so am excited to see it here on amazon (at a much better price!). The package includes the noodles, sauce mix, and a tiny packet of chopped peanuts. I usually add about 6 oz. very thinly-sliced chicken, a cup or two of frozen or fresh veggies (whatever I have on hand), and extra chopped peanuts as the included packet of peanuts is, as I said, VERY small. I've also added shrimp & veggies and that turned out well too. It's a quick, tasty, healthy dinner (with enough left over for lunch & sometimes dinner the next day). Note that the sauce is quite mild (which is fine with me) - if you like spicier foods, you'll probably need to add some sort of hot sauce to it. Overall very easy to make and yummy too!

(NOTE, this was my review of the exact same product back in November of 2007 ... I think amazon stopped carrying it for awhile as my old review now says "this item is currently unavailable." I was bummed until I searched for it and found it. Maybe the code number changed or something, but it's the same product.)

This Tea was highly recommended and after reading the reviews I was excited to try it.  I really can't tell a big difference.  I've been drinking it for about 2 weeks and I have lost about 2-3lbs, more so inches.  However, I have been eating better and exercising more.  It has not made me regular (if you know what I mean).  I'm still going to continue to drink it and I've purchased my second box.
Excellent product, easy to use packages.  Keep the remainder in freezer until using.

Summary: Probably the most effective "natural" supplement I've seen
Text: My wife used this to increase her milk supply towards the end of nursing and it far surpassed any expectations.
I love this coffee.  So far have only had the vanilla but going to try the others.  It is like having a cappuccino in a coffee house. Try it, you'll love it.

Walden Farms salad dressings are a hit and miss. Some of them are a bit off, and some of them are really good, so I decided to try 'Asian' and was delighted. Wasn't sure what I was expecting, but the taste is very much like soy sauce with a slightly thicker consistency. I love to pour it over chicken or fish and then pop it in the oven. The only downsides have nothing to do with the quality/taste. 1, Sodium. This is to be expected with most salad dressings. If you eat it in moderation it shouldn't be an issue, but since it's zero calorie, some people think it's ok to pile it on. This isn't the case. 2, Price. The price tag might turn off the average consumer, but for me it's a trade off for the taste that I love and the zero calories/zero sugar advantages.

If you're curious, and just want to try it out, I say go for it. If you're a dieter and are looking for a serious way to cut calories, I say DEFINITELY try it out.

I use this stuff to cook with - it's indispensible for me in the kitchen and at the table because I count calories, but love the taste of butter. Summary: Heavenly snack for a coconut lover!
Text: We're on vacation in Maui and I happened to pick up a bag Danielle's coconut chips from a shave ice vendor down the street. I LOVE coconut but get discouraged by all the over-sugared options. I got disgusted with the garlic powder sold in bulk at health food stores and natural food groceries. It rarely has much garlic flavor and was way too hot and the quality was very inconsistent at stores that did sometimes sell something good.

I'm now half way through my second jar of Tone's, which is consistently excellent. It has a strong garlic flavor and is not hot unless you use a lot on something like broccoli. It is way better than raw garlic cloves. They must have an excellent source of garlic for their powder. If you have doubts about your current garlic powder, smell it. If it doesn't have a strong garlic smell, it's just white powder. Get this Tone's and you'll get your delicious food back.

Summary: One cat eats them, one won't
Text: My vet gave me a sample of these because both my cats had some tartar build up, and one needed a (expensive!) teeth cleaning. One of my cats loved them, she actually carried it around with her before eating it. It's kind of like a toy for her, which gives her something to do. The other cat turned her nose up and walked away. I haven't been feeding them long enough to my cats to comment on whether they reduce tartar and build up, but I do give my dog these same treats (the dog chews) and they help her breath and teeth SO much. Every time I take her to the vet, they comment on how clean her teeth are. So I'm hoping it will help my cats teeth out that much also.

He has always thrown up food at least 3 times a week and I thought it was just something we had to put up with.  He also began licking his fur completely off his tummy.  After reading many reviews on different cat foods, I tried Blue Buffalo.  He did stop throwing up but he did not like it.  We tried the Taste of the Wild and he loves it.  It may be pricier but he eats less and doesn't throw it up.  I can't tell you how many rolls of paper towels and Resolve carpet cleaner we used to go through with the Purina food. Five weeks into 2010 and I have 5 round trips on United Airlines. These past two months I've been delayed a at least 5 times. Stuck on a plane with nothing to munch on is just no fun at all. Brothers All Natural Crisps come to the rescue. These little bags weigh absolutely nothing; they are almost as light as air. They are TSA super friendly, you can't take whole fruit in carryon luggage any more. They taste great and they are a healthy snack. These are just the thing to help get over those darn inevitable delays.

This is the first time I've had freeze dried fruit in a bag. It's a bit of a surprise the first time you open the bag. The strawberry and banana smell is intense and fresh. Each piece of fruit is big. The strawberries have a clean natural strawberry flavor. They dissolve quickly in your mouth and are not the least bit gummy. The bananas absorb the strawberry flavor and have a bit of mushy flavor to them. The bananas do not have as clean a taste as the strawberries. The banana still tastes very good.

In fact the eating experience is a lot like eating a real piece of fruit. These are nothing at all like fruit leathers or fruit chews that are gummy and soft.

Grandpa and Grandson loved these. They are going to be a treat in the 13 year old's lunch. In fact the first night I had these, my son tasted them said he liked them. Then a few minutes later I left the bag sitting around and he asked if he could eat the rest. My son is a fairly picky eater, and he just flat out liked these.

They are a good choice for lunches and traveling. Oh, and camping food - just about the most perfect thing in the world.

We used to feed our dogs this until we read the ingredients. Despite being promoted as a premium, healthy dog food, this is not. It is made by Purina. The first two ingredients are corn (not good for dogs) and chicken by product (not good for anyone). Buy something else.

I've got 4 cats and every one of them likes this food, which makes things much simpler than when we were buying several different brands/flavors. Like most cat food, this food has pretty much everything they need, but it seems to be gentler on them than others we've tried - while there's still the occasional throwing up (they are, after all, cats), it seems reduced with this food over what we'd tried before, which was pretty much everything from Eukanuba to Meow Mix. Additionally, these size bags are pretty much the perfect size for our group - large enough that I can just drop a whole bag into the feeder and not worry about it for a number of days, but small enough that it doesn't go stale before they've finished it.

The only negative here is that Amazon doesn't always seem to be able to keep it in stock. Several times, I've needed to order it and they've been out of stock and I've had to go to local sources for it. I do wish Amazon (or their supplier) would get their act together here. Also, I wish this fell under the "subscribe and save" program, especially since it's something that gets used up on a very regular basis.
Gloria Jeans has a great product of Hazelnut flavored coffee.  The product is liked by all my colleagues.  The transaction via Amazon was prompt and efficient.  Will buy again from Amazon.

Summary: When lactose is a problem, Sensitive formula is a good solution.
Text:
There have been some harsh reviews about the ingredients in the liquid Similac Sensitive. It is true that milk based formula should be first choice as it is closest to mother's milk. When milk can't be used due to a lactose intolerance, another form of carbohydrate is needed. Corn maltodextrin is just an easily digested sugar. It IS used as a "filler" in adult food. This is not always a good thing because as adults we don't need extra empty calories. Babies DO need the calories and easily processed sugar are a gentile way to get them. There is a history of (baby and adult) lactose intolerance on my husbands side. After trying to reduce gas in many other ways, we switched and have seen a great reduction in gas amount and pains. It has not been a cure, but with other gas management techniques, we are all happier.

Pros: Already made for travel or middle of the night feedings. Good for babies that are sensitive to lactose.

Summary: Great water, but bogus marketing claims
Text:
Essentia water tastes great, and its price is in the same ball park as other good quality bottled water. However, stating that the 9.5 pH is good for you is completely devoid of any scientific substance. In fact, there are a lot of scientific studies that completely refute these claims. There's a page by a retired chemistry professor, who rips into the variety of similar "alkalanized" and "ionized" water marketing claims. Most importantly, his page contains a lot of links to University and other scientific research results that all undermine the important of the 9.5 pH. Having said all that, I do like the taste of Essentia water, so whatever minerals it has in it does make for great tasting, pleasant to drink water. Just don't fall for the pH hype until and unless you read the science reports instead of trusting any marketing hype.

I just sent this as a wedding gift last week, now found several sites that say this is a hoax. They say you can't really name a star, it's only done through certain organization called IAU, here is Wikipedia's answer:

The International Astronomical Union (IAU) is the internationally recognized authority which designates stars, planets, asteroids, comets, and other heavenly bodies according to internationally accepted rules. The IAU does not sell naming rights nor does it authorize any other company or organization to do so. The IAU cautions consumers that products and services marketed by ISR and other companies have no formal or official validity whatsoever. In fact with a few exceptions of ancient or Arabic names, nearly all stars are designated by catalog numbers rather than names.[8]

The IAU has called the ISR's star-naming business far from dangerous "charlatanry" and their products and marketing have been criticised for "seem[ing] official."[9][10] The company clarifies the products it sells on its frequently asked questions page stating:

Astronomers will not recognize your name because your name is published only in our Star catalog.[4]

Yerba Mate is my drink. I've sampled many brands, all organic, and Mate Factor shines brightly above them all. Put the herb in your gourd or cup and let it exfoliate in cool water for several minutes. Then add hot (not boiling) water. Smell it again as you watch it bubble to life. If you are already a mate drinker you will be delightfully surprised as the infusion rises through your bombilla into your mouth. This is like no other mate. It is rich, fresh, well balanced and full of life. On the "circle of drink" website, their reviewer describes it as the hot chocolate of mates. If you're concerned about the package size and the beans going stale, it freezes well. I pack the beans in a Mason jar, then remove the air using a food vacuum and this attachment: FoodSaver T03-0023-01 Wide-Mouth Jar Sealer

Keeps for months in the freezer without any appreciable loss of flavor. Be sure to let the jar come up to room temperature before opening it so you don't get condensation on the cold beans (I usually leave the jar sit for a day before opening it). You also should not defrost and re-freeze the beans - use a jar that is sized to hold about what you would use up in a week (for me, that's a quart size jar).
